title: HOW THE SMP TREATMENT WORKS – HAIR TATTOO STEP BY STEP

hero.heading: HOW HAIR TATTOO SCALP MICROPIGMENTATION WORKS – STEP BY STEP
hero.subtitle: Scalp Micropigmentation is not just a treatment – it's a process that works to deliver real, visible results through carefully planned steps. Each session has its purpose, and together they create an effect that looks completely natural.

sections.title: CONSULTATIONS – IN PERSON OR ONLINE
bullets: Detailed analysis of the scalp and skin type
Discussion about your goals and expectations
Proposal of the front hairline shape
Number of sessions and density assessment
text: Consultations are conducted at the studio or via WhatsApp/Viber video calls.

sections.title: FIRST SESSION – BASE LAYER
text: This session sets the foundation – the first visible effect of scalp micropigmentation appears here.
bullets: Draw the agreed hairline
Start base layer pigmentation (hair tattoo)
Determine coverage of main areas (top, crown, sides)
Second session is performed 10–20 days after the first
Pigment from the first session has stabilized
Increase density, create smooth transitions between areas
Start forming realistic 'hair stubble' effect

sections.title: THIRD SESSION – FINISHING AND BALANCING
bullets: Final refinement of all areas
Detail enhancement and possible front hairline corrections
Final check of density and uniformity
text: If necessary, a fourth session is possible – at no additional cost.

sections.title: WHAT TO DO AND WHAT TO AVOID AFTER THE TREATMENT
bullets: Dry healing for the first 24 hours – do not wet the treated area
Use a healing balm
Gently dry the treated area with a clean paper towel, do not rub
If it itches – gently tap, do not scratch
Wear a hat or cap outdoors
Once healed – use sunscreen (SPF) to protect the pigment
Maintain short haircut for optimal results
Avoid excessive sweating in the first 24 hours
Do not wash hair for the first 3 days
Do not use clippers for 3 days
Do not shave your head for 5 days
Avoid styling products (gel, wax, etc.) for 7 days
Pause Minoxidil for 7 days
Do not swim in the sea or pool for 14 days
Avoid sauna and tanning bed for one month

Following these instructions significantly improves healing and the long-lasting effect of SMP.

faqs.title: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS ABOUT THE SMP PROCESS

list.q: How long does one session last?
list.a: It usually lasts between 2 and 4 hours, depending on the size of the treated area.

list.q: Can I go to work after the treatment?
list.a: Yes – most clients resume daily activities the next day.
